channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Several top-tier players jailed pending trial in Turkish football betting probe
item.description: Türkiye’s widening football betting scandal intensified on Dec. 9 after an Istanbul court ordered the pre-trial detention of 20 suspects, including top-tier players, club presidents and referees.

item.title: Fenerbahçe aims for win in Norway
item.description: A high-stakes showdown in Norway awaits as Brann hosts Turkish giant Fenerbahçe on Dec. 11, with both clubs battling for critical positioning in the UEFA Europa League league phase.

item.title: Göbeklitepe to boost visitor capacity with new investments
item.description: A new welcome center, rest areas, walking paths and expanded parking facilities are under construction at Göbeklitepe, a UNESCO World Heritage site hailed as the “zero point of history,” with completion expected next year as authorities aim to increase both visitor numbers and site capacity.

item.title: Istanbul tops global traffic ranking as drivers lost 118 hours to congestion
item.description: Istanbul drivers have lost an average of 118 hours to congestion this year, making the metropolis the world’s most gridlocked city for the second year in a row, according to new data released by U.S.-based traffic analytics firm Inrix.

item.title: Erhürman aims to rebuild Turkish Cyprus’ image in Türkiye
item.description: Turkish Cyprus needs to change its image in Türkiye, which is largely associated with casinos, illegal money and mafia networks, Turkish Cypriot President Tufan Erhürman has said.

item.title: US moving closer to resolving F-35 issue with Türkiye: Envoy
item.description: The close relationship between U.S. President Donald Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has brought the countries closer to resolving issues that led to Türkiye being kicked off the F-35 fighter jet program, the United States ambassador to Ankara said on Dec. 10.

item.title: Australia bans under-16s from social media in world-first crackdown
item.description: Australia banned under-16s from social media in a world-first crackdown on Wednesday, declaring it was time to "take back control" from formidable tech giants.

item.title: Kremlin says Trump's Ukraine statements in line with Russia's view
item.description: The Kremlin on Wednesday said U.S. President Donald Trump's latest statements on Ukraine — in which he said Moscow will win the war and that Kyiv will have to cede land — align with Russia's view.

item.title: Terror-free Türkiye to pave way for terror-free region: Erdoğan
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has declared that Türkiye is firmly committed to eliminating terrorism within its borders, adding that a terror-free Türkiye will pave the way for a terror-free region, and vowing to pursue this end with patience and determination.

item.title: Türkiye won’t allow new chaos in Syria: Fidan
item.description: Türkiye won’t allow new chaos in Syria as instability and insecurity in this country has negative impacts for the entire region, the Turkish foreign minister has said, noting uncertainty over the YPG’s integration with the Syrian army and Israel’s continued expansionist policies as two major challenges for Syria and beyond.
